notes.title: Small Navigation Patch for Summon Creature
notes.notes:
Just a small patch to fix some navigation issues with the new Summon ability creature,


 Think We're Alone Now level fixed the summon creature's path finding so they don't get stuck on pillars.
 Learning to Haunt level fixed the summon creature's path finding so they don't get stuck on the canteen doorway.

notes.title: New 'Summon' mechanic and some bug fixes
notes.notes:
I've been busy trying to improve the experience of Poltergeist Prodigy and have resolved some bugs, boosted performance, and even added a new 'Summon' mechanic.

New feature: A new haunting ability 'Summon' has been added. On the Learning to Haunt and Think We're Alone Now levels, you can find a summoning point. If you interact with this summoning point you will summon a creature who will automatically wander the level and haunt NPCs.

Bug fix: On the Learning to Haunt level, a teacher NPC's walk animation would occasionally fail to trigger.

Bug fix: On the 666 to Spooksville level the female NPCs would scream with a man's voice.

Bug fix: Once the Pulse haunting ability is unlocked you could trigger it whilst on the Options menu.

Bug fix: Once the Possession haunting ability is unlocked you could trigger scares and unpossess of an NPC whilst in the Options menu.

Performance improvement: Code refactoring and clean up to improve performance.

notes.title: Post Release Patch
notes.notes:
It's been a few days since release and now it's out in the wild a couple of minor bugs and nuisances have reared their heads, so a minor patch is ready to solve them.

This patch addresses the following:


 Fear energy received sound effect now has a random pitch applied to add variety to the sound.
 Air conditioner units in Holy Ghost level now react to NPCs if they are primed.
 Bug where if any primed object was in the same room as a priest NPC they would react to normal scares has been fixed.
 Ghost lighting adjusted in Holy Ghost level so during the opening dialogue the wall is lit consistently.
 Candles in the Cryptic Beginnings level will now move when interacted with.
 Bug where invisible barriers would prevent manifest ability being used across doorway thresholds fixed.
